## Services

Sovereign Technology provides full-spectrum AI operations — from model selection to production operations, every layer of the AI stack:

1. **AI Development**
   Custom model training, fine-tuning, and prompt engineering — AI built for your domain, not generic chatbots.
   Technologies: Fine-Tuning, RAG Pipelines, Multi-Agent Systems, Domain Training

2. **AI Deployment** (core offering)
   Production-grade deployment on your infrastructure — bare metal, cloud, or hybrid. Containerized, orchestrated, and monitored from day one.
   Technologies: Kubernetes-Native, GPU Optimization, Auto-Scaling, Zero-Downtime Rollouts

3. **AI Operations**
   24/7 monitoring, incident response, and continuous optimization. Your AI runs at peak performance — always.
   Technologies: Real-Time Monitoring, Incident Response, Cost Optimization, Drift Detection

4. **Sovereign Infrastructure**
   Your data never leaves your perimeter. On-premises or private cloud — with full encryption, audit logging, and compliance built in.
   Technologies: On-Prem & Private Cloud, E2E Encryption, Audit Trails, GDPR & SOC 2

5. **AI Integration**
   Connect AI to your existing systems — ERP, CRM, databases, APIs. Seamless integration without disrupting workflows.
   Technologies: API-First, ERP/CRM Connectors, Legacy Bridging, Event Pipelines

6. **AI Strategy & Audit**
   We audit your operations, identify the highest-impact AI opportunities, and build the roadmap from pilot to production.
   Technologies: Readiness Assessment, ROI Modeling, Technology Selection, Roadmap

## The Sovereign AI Stack

A battle-tested infrastructure stack designed for sovereignty, performance, and reliability:

- **Application Layer:** Multi-Agent Orchestrator, RAG Engine, API Gateway, Web UI
- **Inference Layer:** vLLM / TGI, Model Router, Batch Scheduler, Cache Layer
- **Orchestration Layer:** Kubernetes, Helm Charts, GPU Scheduler, Istio
- **Infrastructure Layer:** NVIDIA A100/H100, Private Cloud, Bare Metal, Terraform

---

## Process: From Idea to Production in Weeks

1. **Discovery & Audit** — We analyze your data, infrastructure, and business objectives. We identify the highest-impact AI use cases and build the business case.
2. **Architecture & Design** — We design the sovereign AI architecture — model selection, infrastructure sizing, security model, and integration points. You review and approve.
3. **Build & Train** — We develop, fine-tune, and test. Every component is built for your domain. We iterate with your team until the quality bar is met.
4. **Deploy & Harden** — Production deployment with monitoring, alerting, and auto-scaling. Security hardening, load testing, and compliance checks. Go-live ready.
5. **Operate & Optimize** — We run it. 24/7 monitoring, incident response, performance tuning, and continuous improvement. Your AI gets better every month.

## Pricing

Published rates — no "contact us for a quote" games:

- **Sovereign AI Hosting** — $30–100/month by GPU allocation
  Hosted open-source AI stack (Ollama / Open WebUI) on our infrastructure. Dedicated tenancy with isolated resources, offsite encrypted backups, uptime monitoring, and quarterly vulnerability scans.

- **Private AI Box** — $2,000–5,000 setup + $50–150/month care plan
  Local LLM appliance for confidentiality-sensitive teams (law firms, clinics, finance). Hardware and model stack installed on-premises; your data never leaves the building. Secure remote management tunnel and quarterly vulnerability scans included.

- **AI Operations Retainer** — from $500/month
  Fully managed AI production stack: 24/7 monitoring and incident response, performance and cost optimization, model drift detection, and quarterly vulnerability scans.

Project engagements (development, deployment, integration) are scoped individually. AI Strategy & Audit engagements start at $2,500.

Bitcoin-native pricing: 5% discount for payment in Bitcoin (sats via BTCPay).

## Open Source Licensing

By default, Sovereign Technology open-sources everything we create under the AGPL-3.0 license (GNU Affero General Public License v3). All non-confidential code, configurations, and tools we build for you are released openly — giving you full transparency and control.

You have the freedom to use, modify, and deploy your own updates to the code we write. You own what you pay for. Any modifications must also remain open-source, ensuring the community benefits and the code stays auditable.

Custom license releases are available for an additional fee — allowing proprietary use or alternative licensing terms when required.

Source: https://github.com/sovitxyz

## About

### Sovereign Technology SAS

Sovereign Technology SAS is an AI operations company registered in El Salvador. We are AI infrastructure engineers, ML practitioners, and systems architects who believe AI should serve its owners — not the other way around.

The company grew out of sovIT.xyz, a Bitcoin-native IT consultancy known for sovereign, open-source infrastructure. That engineering DNA runs through everything we build: self-hosted, auditable, and free of lock-in. Today we develop, deploy, and operate sovereign AI systems for organizations across Latin America and beyond.

Operating principles: Sovereignty First (your data, your models, your rules) — Production Grade (not prototypes, production systems) — Open Standards (no lock-in, open source at the core).

### Cameron — Founder

Cameron began gaming on PCs at a very young age. In elementary school, he made videos and simple animations in Microsoft Movie Maker with his brother. By 6th grade, at age 11, he started making websites using Zoomshare templates — simple game sites built by copying and pasting his favorite Flash games from other websites into the template. Around the same time, he got into competitive FPS gaming and built his first computer.

At 13, he received a netbook from Santa and began experimenting with Kali Linux and an Alfa AWUS036NHA adapter, exploring wireless security and learning how WEP networks could be tested and cracked. Around the same time, he started coding in VB.NET and piecing together open-source code in C++. Cameron has always been passionate about all aspects of computing.

In high school, he became the go-to person for computer help — repairing and imaging systems for family members, friends from church, classmates, and even teachers. These experiences helped him develop strong technical and troubleshooting skills.

He later built the most powerful workstation/gaming computer possible (2017) and worked as an IT professional at Health First, gaining valuable experience in enterprise IT environments. Today, Cameron leads Sovereign Technology — deploying and operating sovereign, open-source AI systems and serving others through technology they truly own.
